clue.text: Interpret measure in article that's clich-ridden

indicators.note: in says the two pieces sit inside the article

parts.note: THE is the definite article
to read something is to interpret it
a bar is a measure in music

explanation.surface: A dull, hackneyed piece of writing whose meaning someone sets out to interpret.
explanation.walkthrough: The scan prints 'cliché-ridden'; the accent was lost in OCR.
explanation.definitionFit: A threadbare argument or phrase is worn out through overuse, just like hackneyed, stale writing.

clue.text: They occur daily, i.e. when fully rearranged

indicators.note: rearranged says the letters of the written-out phrase are reordered

parts.note: written in full, the abbreviation i.e. is the Latin id est

explanation.surface: Something happens every day, that is, once it has been completely reorganised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'i.e.' must be expanded to ID EST before the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea rises and falls twice every day.

clue.text: Unhappy term without kind old master

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so these letters go round the other piece
unhappy suggests the letters of the word term are disturbed

parts.note: a brand is a kind or make

explanation.surface: A sad end comes to a kind old painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Rembrandt is the great seventeenth-century Dutch painter, an Old Master.

clue.text: George the First included in gun scheme

parts.note: an automatic is a self-loading gun

indicators.note: included in says one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a plot is a scheme
the First, as in a monarch's title, is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: King George the First takes part in a plot involving firearms.
explanation.walkthrough: George is British slang for an aircraft's automatic steering system.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilots nicknamed the autopilot George, so the name stands for the device.

clue.text: Work piled up behind part of mathematician's table

parts.note: back means behind
a log is an entry in logarithm tables

explanation.surface: Unfinished work accumulates behind a mathematician's desk.
explanation.definitionFit: A backlog is a build-up of work waiting to be done.

clue.text: Change form of Scottish dance outside Highland gathering

indicators.note: outside says the dance goes round the gathering

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance
a Mod is a Gaelic festival of music and poetry in the Scottish Highlands

explanation.surface: A Scottish dance changes shape at a Highland event.
explanation.definitionFit: To remodel something is to alter its shape or structure.

clue.text: Political allies stop short, lacking king

indicators.note: lacking says the letter for the king is taken out of the word for stop short

parts.note: to block someone is to stop them short, halting them abruptly
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Allies in politics halt before the finish, missing their monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' also hints at the cut: the word loses its final letter, the king's K.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is a group of nations or parties allied for a common political purpose.

clue.text: Area of endless threat to crops

indicators.note: endless says the final letter is cut off

parts.note: swarms of locusts strip crops

explanation.surface: A region suffers a never-ending danger to its harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: A locus is a place or position, a particular area.

clue.text: Series of sharp bends on railway that's deceptive

parts.note: a chicane is a tight S-bend on a racetrack

explanation.surface: A twisty railway route turns out to be misleading.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicanery is trickery, conduct that is deceptive.

clue.text: Alert for everyone, as most of 24 conked out

annotationWithheld.why: Alert for everyone, as most of 24 conked out (3,5,2,4): 24 is NEWSY, and no reading of 'most of 24' with 'as' and 'conked' gives the letters LLHAND needed
annotationWithheld.clue: Alert for everyone, as most of 24 conked out

clue.text: Popular protest movement out of control

parts.note: a demo is a protest march
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: A popular protest march that gets out of hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Demotic means of or for ordinary people, so popular in the sense of common.

clue.text: Book's contribution to optimal achievement

indicators.note: contribution to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A book plays its part in someone reaching their best.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book's' reads as possessive, but it is Book is: Malachi is a book of the Old Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: Malachi is the last book of the Old Testament, named after its prophet.

clue.text: Haphazardly thrown together and quickly sent flying

definitions.meaning: mixed up in a jumble, like eggs beaten in a pan
fighter aircraft are rushed into the air in an emergency

explanation.surface: Something hastily assembled and then hurled through the air.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrambled describes things jumbled at random and also fighter planes ordered urgently aloft.

clue.text: Main addition to house for author of verse collection

indicators.note: addition to says the second piece is placed after the first

parts.note: the main is the open sea

explanation.surface: A poet gets a sea-view extension built onto their home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' is the poetic word for the sea, not 'principal'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosea is the prophet credited with the Old Testament book in poetic verse bearing his name.

clue.text: Musical group I included in sort of contract

indicators.note: included in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: NT is no-trumps, a contract in the card game bridge
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A band member is written into a particular kind of deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is an ensemble of nine musicians.

clue.text: Nocturnal creature's strange thing to carry for sale

definitions.note: the 's stands for is: the creature is the answer

indicators.note: strange says the letters of the word thing are made odd

parts.note: to hawk goods is to carry them about selling

explanation.surface: A night-time animal has an odd item to peddle.
explanation.definitionFit: The nighthawk is an American nightjar, a bird active at dusk and night.

clue.text: Windswept girl producing flower

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
out in a gale, so blown about by the wind

explanation.surface: A girl blown about by the wind brings forth a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Galingale is a sedge plant whose aromatic root was used as a spice; here loosely a flower.

clue.text: Negative comment about one as human being

indicators.note: about says the word for a human being goes round the other piece

parts.note: a person is a human being
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A critical remark concerning someone as a person.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast aspersions is to make damaging remarks, so an aspersion is a negative comment.

clue.text: Detain Conservative ill-advised to join party unofficially

parts.note: to gate a pupil is to confine them to school as punishment
a rash act is ill-advised

explanation.surface: A Tory is held back for unwisely trying to enter a political party without due process.
explanation.walkthrough: 'party' suggests politics beside 'Conservative', but it is a social gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: To gatecrash is to attend a party or event without an invitation.

clue.text: A curt refusal to obey I encountered in some Africans

parts.note: shan't is a short, rude refusal

explanation.surface: A brusque rebellious no is met in a group of people from Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ashanti are a people of central Ghana in West Africa.

clue.text: Son tucked into casserole in volatile situation

indicators.note: tucked into says the boy goes inside the dish

parts.note: a hotpot is a meat and potato casserole, as in Lancashire hotpot

explanation.surface: A boy digs into a stew amid a tense situation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucked into' suggests eating, but it means placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot spot is a place of danger or unrest liable to flare up.

clue.text: Native soldier rejected agreement about operation

indicators.note: rejected says the whole assembly is turned back
about says one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: yes is an expression of agreement

explanation.surface: An indigenous soldier turns down a deal concerning a military operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' applies to the whole assembly, not only to the word for agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A sepoy was an Indian soldier serving under British or European command.

clue.text: One of these bones found in Paul's birthplace

definitions.text: One of these bones found in Paul's birthplace

parts.words: One of these bones found in Paul's birthplace
parts.note: St Paul was born in Tarsus, which is also the name for a single ankle bone; the clue asks for the plural

explanation.definitionFit: Tarsus, Paul's home city, is also the singular of these ankle bones, so the plural is wanted.

clue.text: Keep damaging fabric in cathedral city

parts.note: to rip cloth is to tear it
on means continuing, as in keep on

explanation.surface: Someone keeps tearing cloth in a city with a cathedral.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Keep damaging fabric' as 'rip on', tear continuously.
explanation.definitionFit: Ripon is a small city in North Yorkshire known for its cathedral.

clue.text: Successes in theatre a sort of accident

definitions.meaning: a hit and a long run are both marks of a successful show
a road collision where the driver flees the scene

explanation.surface: Theatrical triumphs turn out to be some kind of mishap.
explanation.definitionFit: A hit and a run are stage successes; joined, they name a crash where the driver drives off.

clue.text: Full of intelligence, novel ends in curious way

parts.note: novel means new

indicators.note: ends in says the final letters of the next two words are taken

explanation.surface: A clever novel ends oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: Newsy means full of news, and intelligence is information or news.

clue.text: Long to blow highly-effective instrument

parts.note: a very long wooden horn blown high in the mountains, heard across valleys

explanation.definitionFit: The alpine horn is a very long wooden trumpet-like instrument played high in the Alps.

clue.text: See ahead and quietly criticise

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
to review a work is to criticise it

explanation.surface: Someone looks forward and softly passes judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: To preview a film or play is to see it before its general release.

clue.text: Honour for man indispensable on board

definitions.meaning: in bridge the top cards, ace to ten, are called honours
the chess piece whose loss ends the game

explanation.surface: A distinction awarded to a vital member of a company's board.
explanation.definitionFit: The king is an honour card in bridge and the one chess piece the game cannot go on without.

clue.text: Spy chief, I venture, only erasing cipher in error

parts.note: M is the head of MI6 in the James Bond stories
to stake money is to venture it

indicators.note: erasing says a letter is wiped out of the word only

parts.note: a cipher is a zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: An intelligence boss risks money but wrongly destroys only the code.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cipher' suggests a code, but here it means nought.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something mistakenly means doing it in error.
